gyeongjuWorldPlanner.title: When should you visit Gyeongju World?
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.intro: Compare weather and expected crowds for an outdoor visit to Gyeongju World.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.caution: The forecast calls for caution outdoors. Check the latest forecast and official operating notices.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.scoreHelp: A comparison score combining weather and calendar assumptions, not satisfaction or predictive accuracy.

reasons.dry: Less than 0.5 mm of rain is expected during the comparison window.
reasons.lightRain: Light rain is forecast. Bring a raincoat.
reasons.rain: Rain may affect outdoor activities and rides.
reasons.comfortable: Daytime temperatures of 14–27°C are relatively comfortable outdoors.
reasons.cold: Some daytime periods are below 14°C. Bring an extra layer.
reasons.hot: Daytime temperatures exceed 27°C. Prepare for heat.
reasons.holiday: A public holiday is assumed to be busier than a normal weekday.
reasons.weekend: Weekends are assumed to be busier than weekdays.
reasons.friday: Fridays are assumed to be busier than other weekdays.
reasons.weekday: Monday–Thursday is assumed to be quieter than weekends.
reasons.wind: Windy periods are forecast. Check official ride notices.
reasons.indoor: An indoor visit reduces rain, temperature and wind penalties. Outdoor ride operation is not guaranteed.

gyeongjuWorldPlanner.dateListIntro: Select a day for weather periods and the reasoning behind its score.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.visitWindow: We compare 10:00–18:00 KST. Check official opening and closing times.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.coarse: This date includes 6–12 hour forecast intervals; fine hourly differences are unavailable.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.prorated: Rain totals are apportioned by the overlap between forecast intervals and the visit window, not exact timing or probability.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.noDataHelp: A fresh forecast with at least six daytime hours is unavailable. We do not show recommendation scores until data is sufficient.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.noScope: No weekend or holiday has sufficient forecast data. Try including weekdays.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.timezone: All dates and times use Korea Standard Time (KST).
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.weatherSourceDetail: Global numerical forecasts near Gyeongju World (35.837, 129.281), checked about hourly. Not a substitute for KMA warnings or on-site observations.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.methodology: Weather scores use temperature, precipitation and wind during the visit window. Crowds are estimated from weekdays and public holidays. Weather/calendar weights are 70/30 for a relaxed visit, 85/15 with children and 80/20 for rides. Rain, cold, wind and thunderstorms lower scores.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.limitations: Crowds currently use preliminary weekday/holiday rules, without attendance, events, groups, school holidays or reservations. This is not a validated attendance or wait prediction model.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.safetyRule: At least 8 mm rain, 9 m/s wind, freezing or 33°C+ temperatures, or a thunderstorm signal caps suitability at 45 points. These are ToolHub comparison rules, not ride closure thresholds.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.staleRule: Recommendations stop when forecast issue or fetch time is over 24 hours old. Recheck before travelling, especially for distant dates.
gyeongjuWorldPlanner.independent: An independent ToolHub reference service, not an official Gyeongju World service.

faq.q: Which weekday is best for Gyeongju World?
faq.a: With other conditions equal, compare Monday to Thursday first. Holidays, events and group visits can change this pattern. This page combines current forecasts with an explanation for each date.

faq.q: Is a rainy day better because it is quieter?
faq.a: We do not assume rain makes the park quieter. Rain reduces visit suitability because it may affect outdoor activities and ride operations.

faq.q: Do recommendations change for children or rides?
faq.a: The family profile puts more weight on weather and comfortable temperatures. The ride profile penalizes rain more heavily. After choosing a date, use the map to check ride locations and current operating status.
No. They are relative estimates based on weekdays and public holidays, not validated attendance or waiting-time predictions.

faq.q: How far ahead can I compare?
faq.a: Dates with sufficient daytime coverage within MET Norway’s approximately nine-day forecast. Dates five or more days away are marked as tentative.

faq.q: Can rain or wind affect Gyeongju World rides?
faq.a: Outdoor facilities may change operations due to weather or maintenance. Scores describe visit suitability, not individual ride operations. Check official hours and closure notices before travelling.

gyeongjuWorldPlanner.todayPartial: Today is excluded from full-day recommendations when earlier forecast periods are missing.

gyeongjuWorldPlanner.areaNote: Temperatures, rain and wind are outdoor forecasts. Indoor visits reduce weather penalties and weight, but travel risks and operating restrictions still apply.

calendar.title: Gyeongju World crowd calendar
calendar.intro: Expected crowds, operating hours and forecast scores, all on one calendar.
calendar.metaDescription: Gyeongju World {year}-{month} calendar with expected crowds, operating hours and weather scores by date.
calendar.summary: {count} relatively quiet weekdays left this month.
calendar.legendScore: pts = weather and crowd score (within the forecast)
calendar.legendHours: ~time = closing time, + = open later than usual
calendar.measuredNote: Average of the median posted wait of operating rides, recorded every 10 minutes from 10:00 to 18:00.
calendar.noForecast: Beyond the forecast range (about 9 days), so only the weekday/holiday crowd rule is shown.
calendar.method: Crowd levels are a weekday/holiday rule (Mon–Thu quieter, Friday moderate, weekends and holidays busy). Hours are park schedules collected by ThemeParks.wiki and may change, so check the official notice before you go.
